title: Bird Watching in Shenzhen
description: Shenzhen is a great place for bird-watching. Apart from 421 types of birds that have been identified, there is a growing population in Shenzhen who voluntarily watch and record the behaviours of local bird species. Jiahong Sui, the Head of the Bird-watching association of Shenzhen University, has brought up her stories of bird-watching in Shenzhen.
